summary: Iteration 3: validated new admin login guard end-to-end. Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_admin_api.py to cover POST /api/admin/login (success + wrong pw + email-as-username), 401 on overview/toggle without Bearer, logout invalidates token, and public regression (send/verify OTP, tracking GET, POST /tracking/{id}/status public, create appointment). 16/16 pytest tests pass. Frontend: fresh /admin renders login form (no dashboard), wrong password shows inline 'Usuário ou senha inválidos.' error, admin/admin@2043 logs in and shows dashboard with KPIs (kpi-em-manutencao=3), token persists in localStorage across reload, mechanic toggle m2 (Disponível↔Ocupado) works with token, advance stage button works, btn-admin-logout clears token and returns to login form. Public regression verified: home page loads, /rastreio/AF-DEMO04 loads DevControlBar and 'Avançar etapa' advances stage without any auth.
critical_code_review_comments: ADMIN_TOKENS is an in-memory set — all sessions are invalidated on backend restart (documented, acceptable for mock app).
Hardcoded ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD in server.py is by design per problem statement, but not suitable for production; should move to env vars + hashed password in a real deployment.
require_admin() is a helper called manually instead of a FastAPI Depends() — works but Depends would be cleaner and centralize header parsing.
test_credentials: Admin: admin / admin@2043 (also email monitor.informatica25@gmail.com works as username). Customer OTP: 123456 for any phone.
seed_data_creation: None (uses existing AF-DEMO01..AF-DEMO06 seeded on backend start).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin auth is fully working. Tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_api.py. Note that ADMIN_TOKENS resets on backend restart, so tests always log in fresh in fixtures. Frontend uses localStorage key 'autofix_admin' for token; testid selectors: admin-login-form, input-admin-username, input-admin-password, btn-admin-login, admin-login-error, admin-dashboard, btn-admin-logout.
